stories.title: Hidden Electrical Dangers Inside Your Walls
stories.description: Common household electrical hazards that develop silently behind walls and often go unnoticed until serious damage occurs.

scenes.hook_text: This danger is already inside your home
scenes.visual_prompt: Cinematic wide shot of a contemporary living room at midnight. The room is empty and silent, bathed in soft, moody blue moonlight with a single warm floor lamp. Extremely slow, smooth doll-in toward a plain drywall wall. High-resolution textures, hyper-realistic, 4k, eerie and quiet atmosphere.
scenes.visual_reference: Establishes that hidden electrical dangers exist inside normal homes without visible warning signs
scenes.negative_prompt: hands, people, text, watermark, logo, cartoon, fast motion, blurry, low resolution
scenes.narration: Some of the most dangerous electrical problems are completely invisible.

scenes.visual_prompt: Macro close-up of a clean, white modern light switch and a standard grounded power outlet on a textured plaster wall. The lighting is neutral and flat. The camera is perfectly static, emphasizing the mundane and 'safe' appearance of the hardware. Photorealistic, sharp focus, 8k.
scenes.visual_reference: Shows common areas where people expect electrical danger, highlighting that the real risk is not visible here
scenes.negative_prompt: hands, people, text, watermark, logo, cartoon, motion blur
scenes.narration: They don’t appear at switches or sockets where people expect them.

scenes.visual_prompt: A technical cross-section cutaway of a residential wall. The camera performs a smooth, motorized lateral trucking shot to reveal yellow Romex cables and copper wiring running behind the gray drywall and between wooden studs. Clean, high-contrast lighting, architectural visualization style.
scenes.visual_reference: Reveals electrical wiring hidden inside walls where heat buildup and insulation failure can occur unseen
scenes.negative_prompt: hands, people, text, watermark, logo, fantasy, messy, chaotic
scenes.narration: Most electrical hazards stay hidden deep inside walls.

scenes.visual_prompt: Extreme macro shot inside a dark wall cavity. Old, dusty electrical wires with cracked, brittle black insulation are bundled tightly together. The camera performs a very slow, creeping push-in. Subtle dust motes dance in a sliver of light. High detail on the crumbling texture of the wire casing.
scenes.visual_reference: Illustrates the danger of aging wires and overloaded circuits that can slowly build heat and trigger electrical fires
scenes.negative_prompt: hands, people, sparks, fire, text, watermark, logo, bright lights, clean wires
scenes.narration: Aging wires and overloaded circuits can quietly build heat over time.

scenes.visual_prompt: Close-up of a messy junction box. Tangled copper wires are haphazardly joined with peeling black electrical tape and loose plastic wire nuts. The camera is static and locked-off, focusing on the poor craftsmanship. Harsh, realistic workshop lighting, high dynamic range.
scenes.visual_reference: Shows the risk of improper DIY electrical repairs that increase resistance and overheating behind walls
scenes.negative_prompt: hands, people, text, watermark, logo, professional wiring
scenes.narration: Improper DIY repairs often increase the danger instead of fixing it.

scenes.visual_prompt: A low-angle shot of a room where a recessed ceiling light sporadically flickers and dims. Simultaneously, a subtle, rhythmic orange heat-haze distortion appears on the wall surface near a baseboard outlet. Static camera, realistic interior shadows, flickering light physics.
scenes.visual_reference: Demonstrates early warning signs of hidden electrical danger such as overheating wires causing flickering lights and warm walls
scenes.negative_prompt: hands, people, text, watermark, logo, explosion, bright fire
scenes.narration: Flickering lights or warm walls are early warning signs.

scenes.visual_prompt: A professional, well-lit shot of a modern metal electrical breaker panel. The door is open, revealing neat, organized rows of switches and perfectly routed insulated wires. Clean, bright, 'commercial' lighting. Static, centered composition, high-end architectural photography style.
scenes.visual_reference: Represents prevention of hidden electrical dangers through inspection and early detection before failure occurs
scenes.negative_prompt: hands, people, text, watermark, logo, dirt, rust, mess
scenes.narration: Most electrical dangers are preventable if they’re found early.
